blurb: Offers dance classes in ballet, jazz, tap, acro, modern, musical theatre, and hip-hop for all ages and levels. Classes run September 14, 2026 through June 7, 2027. Also offers a competitive performance company called Emeralds and summer dance camps.
extraNote: Tuition pro-rated by week joined, no penalty for starting late · Follows Seattle Public School District for snow day/inclement weather cancellations · $35 annual registration fee per student, once per season · Performance fees and costume fees billed separately on auto-pay in October and February · Missed classes can be made up during the current season in a class at or below current level · Lake City studio entrance in the Solara complex, Seattle, WA · September 14, 2026 through June 7, 2027
